posts.text: I don’t object to people voting in federal elections, no matter where they live in our federal Republic. I get very testy about people deciding that they can vote on very local issues that they will then walk away from in just a few years.

I don’t object to people voting in federal elections, no matter where they live in our federal Republic. I get very testy about people deciding that they can vote on very local issues that they will then walk away from in just a few years.

No, because it’s a theory of voting that is about your temporary comfort and not an investment in the place you’re voting. I object to it for the same reason that I object to student participation in issues of long-term college governance.
